title: Tunisian Keto Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy keto wrap recipe from Tunisia, featuring smoky chicken and crunchy rice.

ingredients.name: Smoky spice blend
ingredients.notes: Mix of paprika, garlic powder, and cumin

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together smoky spice blend and olive oil.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the chicken breast.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake the chicken in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, warm the wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble the wrap by spreading cooked rice on the bottom half of the wrap.
Add sliced chicken on top of the rice.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
